data.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Modify COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md to call `review-workflow.sh` (the new multi-cycle orchestrator) instead of (or in addition to) the existing one-shot /dso:review dispatch. Document the arbiter sidecar consumer contract.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: review-workflow.sh is the local entry point called by /dso:commit BEFORE the pre-commit hook fires.

## Implementation

In `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md`:

1. **Locate Step 6 (Review Gate)** — the section that dispatches /dso:review. Update it to call `review-workflow.sh` instead. The shim handles cycle dispatching internally; orchestrator no longer needs to call /dso:review directly for multi-cycle work.

2. **Add explanatory note**: "review-workflow.sh runs N cycles internally (capped at `review.max_cycles`) and dispatches the cycle-end arbiter at halt conditions (max_cycles OR STABLE_HALT with unresolved findings). Output: `arbiter-rulings.json` sidecar consumed by pre-commit-review-gate.sh."

3. **Preserve `enforcement.strategy=ci` skip**: the existing Step 3 skip-block (lines 132-138) that bypasses local review when strategy=ci MUST remain intact. review-workflow.sh inherits the same skip semantics.

4. **Backward compat**: existing single-cycle /dso:review invocations are still valid; they remain the entry point for ad-hoc reviews outside the commit flow. review-workflow.sh is the multi-cycle commit-time orchestrator.

5. **No changes to /dso:commit skill itself**: the skill text already says "execute COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md inline"; the workflow doc is the canonical source.

## Constraints
- CLAUDE.md rule 10: orchestrators MUST execute COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md inline, NEVER invoke /dso:commit via Skill tool from within another workflow. This story does NOT change that rule.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md references review-workflow.sh
  Verify: grep -c 'review-workflow.sh' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md   # expect ≥ 1
- [ ] The enforcement.strategy=ci skip-block is preserved verbatim
  Verify: grep -A 5 'enforcement.strategy=ci.*skipping local /dso:review' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md | head -6
- [ ] Markdown lint passes (if configured)
  Verify: command -v markdownlint && markdownlint plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md || echo "(markdownlint not installed; skipped)"
- [ ] No broken cross-references introduced
  Verify: grep -oE '\[[^]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md | head -5

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (modifications, ~15 lines)
data.title: UPDATE: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md invokes review-workflow.sh for multi-cycle local review
